tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to mix, mingle, confuse, confound
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to mingle, confuse
1a2) to mix
1b) (Hithpoel) to mix oneself (among others)
1c) (Hiphil) to fade away

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to overflow (specifically with oil.); by implication, to mix; to fodder
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; (also  denominatively from H1098 (בְּלִיל)) to fodder
